title_en: APPLICATION FOR NEW/RENEWAL OF BUSINESS PERMIT
title_tl: PROSESO NG NEW/RENEWAL NG BUSINESS PERMIT
content_en:
REQUIREMENTS:
NEW:
DTI or SEC, Contract of Lease and Lessor’s Business Permit or Tax Declaration of Bldg and Land
RENEWAL:
Proof of Gross Sales (Audited Financial Statement, Sworn Declaration, ITR)
PRE-REGISTRATION
(if applicable)
1.	Log in to GO Manila and go to Profile.
2.	Select Business then click Pre-Registration.
3.	Enter your BIN and E-OR/OR and submit.
4.	Fill up required information.
UPLOAD REQUIREMENTS
1.	Go to E-GOVERNMENT and select   Go! BPLS.
2.	Select if New Business or Renewal
3.1	New: fill up information about your business
3.2   Renew: select your business on the list
4.	Select any valid ID for identification or verification.
5.	Upload your requirements, if it is not on the list, upload it in the Other Documents.
6.	Pin the address of your business on the map.
7.	Check the checkbox to agree to the terms and condition and submit
Note: Wait for notification via sms if your application is approved or rejected. If approved, SOA is viewable in Go Manila. If rejected, check the remarks for compliance
STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT (SOA)
1.	Check notification from Go Manila whether : a) FOR RESUBMISSION        b) PENDING.
a.	FOR RESUBMISSION – instructions are found on the remarks section/ indicated in the sms sent
b.	PENDING – You can view your SOA in your Go Manila account
2.	Go to Go Manila > HISTORY > select transaction
a.	SELECT QUARTER – choose to change period of payment (annual, semi-annual, quarterly)
b.	VIEW SOA – View the breakdown of your computation (Convenience fee is not yet included in the computation)
c.	PAY NOW – View the total amount, convenience fee included. Generate reference number and select preferred payment method. (Reference number is good for 24 hours)
PAYMENT
1.	Click PAY NOW and select preferred payment method.  Follow the instructions indicated, screenshot / download the payment instructions Take note of the account name, payment reference number and total amount.
NOTE : The amount indicated in the SOA
does not
include the convenience fee. Kindly check the total amount that will be displayed after selecting preferred payment options.
NOTE : Multipay is no longer the account name that will be used for over-the-counter banking (MC/cash) payment option. It is highly encourage to read carefully the instructions displayed after selecting payment option
Payment Options
OTC Banking (cash)
Manager's Check payment
Online banking
E-wallet
Bayad center
Visa/ Mastercard with 2% charge
Kiosk
NOTE :
Make sure to screeshot/take a picture of payment receipt. An SMS confirmation will be sent when payment is received.
OR AND PERMIT
1.	Go to History > select transaction and click VIEW OR and VIEW PERMIT. Click Download
content_tl:
REQUIREMENTS:
NEW:
DTI or SEC, Contract of Lease and Lessor’s Business Permit or Tax Declaration of Bldg and Land
RENEWAL:
Proof of Gross Sales (Audited Financial Statement, Sworn Declaration, ITR)
PRE-REGISTRATION
(if applicable)
1.	Mag login sa GO Manila at pumunta sa Profile.
2.	Piliin ang Business at pindutin ang  Pre-Registration.
3.	Ilagay ang BIN atE-OR at i-submit.
4.	Punan ang mga hinihinging impormasyon.
UPLOAD REQUIREMENTS
1.	Pumunta sa  E-GOVERNMENT at piliin ang Go! BPLS.
2.	Piliin kung New or Renewal
3.1	New: punuan ang mga impormasyon ng inyong business
3.2   Renew: Piliin ang inyong business sa listahan.
4.	Pumili ng  valid ID para sa pagkilanlan.
5.	I-upload ang mga kinakailangang dokumento, kung hindi tugma sa nasa listahan, i-upload ito saOther Documents.
6.	I-pin ang address ng inyong business sa mapa.
7.	Pindutin angcheckbox para sumagayon sa terms and conditions at i-submit.
Note: Hintayin ang text sa numerong ginamit para sa pabatid kung approved o rejected ang application. Kung approved, makikita ang SOA sa History ng Go Manila. Kung rejected naman ay tignan sa text or sa remarks sa GO Manila ang dahilan.
STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT (SOA)
1.	Tignan sa Go Manila kung : a) FOR RESUBMISSION        b) PENDING.
a.	FOR RESUBMISSION – makikita ang dahilan sa remarks section o sa text na pinadala sa numerong ginamit.
b.	PENDING – Makikita na ang SOA sa Go Manila account
2.	Pumunta sa  Go Manila > HISTORY > piliin ang transaksyon.
a.	SELECT QUARTER – pindutin upang pumili ng period of payment (annual, semi-annual, quarterly)
b.	VIEW SOA – Makikita ng ang babayaran at ang computation (Convenience fee is not yet included in the computation)
c.	PAY NOW – Makikita ang total amount (kasama na ang convenience fee). Mag generate ng reference number sa payment method na nais. (Reference number is good for 24 hours)
PAYMENT
1.	Pindutin ang PAY NOW at piliin ang nais na payment method.  Sundin ang mga direksyong nakasaad. I-download o i-screenshot ang direksyon ng pagbabayad. Tandaan ang account name (kung angkop), payment reference number at total amount.
NOTE : Hindi na Multipay ang gagamiting account name para sa over-the-counter banking (MC/cash) payment option. Masidhing hinihimok ang mga nagbabayad na basahing mabuti ang direksyong nakasaad pagkatapos piliin ang payment option.
Payment Options
OTC Banking (cash)
Manager's Check payment
Online banking
E-wallet
Bayad center
Visa/ Mastercard with 2% charge
Kiosk
NOTE : Siguraduhing i-screeshot/kunan ng larawan ang payment receipt. Magpapadala ng text ng kompirmasyon kapag natanggap na ang bayad.
OR AND PERMIT
1.	Pumunta sa History > piliin ang transaksyon at pindutin ang  VIEW OR at VIEW PERMIT.
2.     Pindutin ang Download.

title_en: HOW TO PAY REAL PROPERTY TAX ONLINE
title_tl: PROSESO PARA SA PAG-BABAYAD NG REAL PROPERTY TAX
content_en:
RPTAX thru GO MANILA
Requirements:
Tax Declaration Number
(AD-00000-00000)
PIN
(117-00-000-000-000 or 117-00-000-000-000-X0000)
Viewable on the OR or Tax declaration
DIRECTION
1. Login to the Go Manila App or go to www.gomanila.com.
2. Select the E-Government
→ Real Property Tax (RPTAX)
→
Tax Payment
3. Enter the Tax Declaration No. and PIN
a. 14-digit PIN - land
b. 19-digit PIN - building
4. Select the year and period (
4
th
Quarter
for annual payment)
5. Review the order of payment and check the inclusive dates (FROM - TO)
6.  Select any Valid ID and click PAY NOW.
e-SOA will be available after this step.
PAYMENT
1. Window will pop up, select preferred payment method and click
PROCEED
.
2. The Payment Reference Number will be displayed together with the total amount due in red font color (
convenience fee included
)
3. Screenshot or copy the reference number and the total amount.
* Makatatanggap ng SMS ng inyong reference number.
PAYMENT thru KIOSK
1. Proceed to the kiosk machines (available at Manila City hall) and scan the QR code or encode the reference number
→ and select CONTINUE TO PAYMENT.
2. Input bills or coins one at a time.
3. Keep the receipt printed by the machine after payment.
4. Users will receive electronic OR in their Go Manila account's HISTORY
*
Y
ou will receive an SMS confirmation of payment.
PAYMENT thru GCASH
Note: Select Kiosk Machine as payment method.
1. Open GCash app and login.
2. Select Bills
→
Government
→
Go Manila.
3. Input Reference Number, amount and contact number.
4. Proceed with payment.
5. Download or screenshot payment confirmation receipt.
6. Users will receive SMS payment confirmation .
7.
Users will receive electronic OR in their Go Manila account's HISTORY.
NOTE:
Transactions that undergo Go Manila has convenience fee included.
Additional 2% for visa/mastercard
Reference number is only valid within 24 hours
content_tl:
PAANO MAGBAYAD NG RPTAX SA GO MANILA
Mga Kailangan:
Tax Declaration Number
(AD-00000-00000)
PIN
(117-00-000-000-000 or 117-00-000-000-000-X0000)
Maaring makita sa dating OR o sa Tax Declaration of Property
PAGPOPROSESO
1.
Pumunta sa Go Manila app o sa
www.gomanila.com
at mag login.
2.
Pindutin ang E-Government → Real Property Tax (RPTAX) → Pindutin ang Tax Payment
3.
Ilagay ang Tax Declaration No. at PIN
a.
14-digit PIN sa lupa
b.
19-digit PIN sa bldg. (pindutin ang ’19-digit format’ na checkbox)
4.
Pindutin ang taon at period (piliin ang 4
th
Quarter para makapagbayad ng buong taon).
5.
Suriin ang order of payment at tignan ang petsa ng babayaran (FROM – TO).
6.
Pumili ng alinmang Valid ID at pindutin ang PAY NOW.
Makikita ang e-SOA pagkatapos ng prosesong ito.
PAGBABAYAD
1.
Lalabas ang bagong window, pumili ng paraan ng pagbabayad na nais at pindutin ang
PROCEED
.
2.
Ang inyong Payment Reference Number
lalabas at ang kabuuang babayaran ay nakasulat sa pula (
kasama ang convenience fee
)
3.
Mag i-screenshot o kopyahin ang reference number at ang total amount.
* Makatatanggap ng SMS ng inyong reference number.
PAGBABAYAD SA KIOSK
1.
Pumunta sa kiosk machine at ilagay or i-scan ang reference number/QR code → pindutin ang CONTINUE TO PAYMENT.
2.
Ipasok ang bills / coins ng paisa isa.
3.
Kunin ang ilalabas na resibo ng kiosk machine.
4.
Makukuha ang electronic OR sa inyong Go Manila’s HISTORY
*
Makatatanggap ng SMS na nagkukumpirma ng pagbabayad
PAYMENT thru GCASH
Note: Piliin ang Kiosk bilang paraan ng pagbabayad.
1.
Pumunta sa GCASH → login
2.
Piliin ang Bills → Government → Go Manila
3.
Ilagay ang Reference number, halaga at contact number
4.
Ituloy at magbayad.
5.
Mag-screenshot payment confirmation receipt.
6.
Makatatanggap ng SMS na nagkukumpirma ng pagbabayad.
7.
Makukuha ang electronic OR sa inyong Go Manila’s HISTORY
NOTE:
·
Ang mga transaksyon na sumailalim sa Go Manila ay
mayroong
convenience fee
·
May karagdagang 2% kapag nagbayad ng
visa/master card
·
Ang reference number ay magagamit lamang sa loob ng 24 oras.

title_en: HOW TO PAY GO MANILA TRANSACTIONS BY USING GCASH APP.
title_tl: PAANO MAG BAYAD NG GO MANILA TRANSACTIONS GAMIT ANG GCASH APP.
content_en:
Click Pay Now and you may:
Option A
1. Select QR Ph and Proceed.
2. Screenshot the QR code provided.
3. Open e-wallet app (e.g. GCash) and open the QR scanner.
4. Scan the QR code and proceed to payment.
Option B
1. Select Kiosk Machine
2. Copy or Screenshot the reference number
3. Open your GCash app
4. Select Bills, Government, Go Manila.
5. Enter reference number, contact number used in Go manila and total amount.
6. Proceed and Pay
content_tl:
Pindutin ang Pay Now at:
Option A
1. Piliin ang QR Ph at mag Proceed.
2. I-screenshot ang QR code na makikita.
3. Buksan ang e-wallet app (e.g. GCash) at buksan ang QR scanner.
4. I-scan ang QR code at magbayad.
Option B
1. Piliin ang Kiosk Machine
2. Kopyahin o i-screenshot ang reference number
3. Buksan ang GCash app
4. Piliin ang Bills, Government, Go Manila.
5. Ilagay ang reference number, contact number na ginamit sa Go manila at kabuuang babayaran.
6. Ituloy ang pagbabayad.

title_en: HOW TO PAY GO MANILA TRANSACTION BY USING GO MANILA E-WALLET FUND
title_tl: PAANO MAGBAYAD NG GO MANILA TRANSACTION GAMIT ANG GO MANILA E-WALLET FUND
content_en:
After completing any of your Go Manila application, click Pay Now and c
hoose any of the payment methods (Go Manila wallet, Kiosk), then click Proceed.
A 10 digit Reference No. and the amount to be paid will be generated for your transaction.
Copy and save the reference no.
Now go to your Go Manila Dashboard and follow these instructions.
Select E-Bills
Select Government
Select Go Manila as biller name
Input the Reference no. and the amount then click Pay Now.
content_tl:
Pagkatapos makumpleto ang inyong Go Manila application, i-click ang Pay Now at pumili ng kahit anuman sa listahan ng
payment methods (
Go Manila wallet, Kiosk
)
at
i-click Proceed.
I-save at kopyahin ang 10 digit Reference No. at halaga ng babayaran para sa inyong transaction.
Pumunta sa inyong Go Manila Dashboard at sundan ang mga proseso na ito:

Piliin ang Government
Piliin ang Go Manila bilang biller name
I-type and Reference no. at ang halaga ng babayaran at i-click ang Pay Now.

title_en: HOW TO GET BIRTH CERTIFICATES FROM 1985-2015 ONLINE
title_tl: PROSESO SA ONLINE SERVICES SA PAGKUHA NG BIRTH CERTIFICATES (KATUNAYAN NG KAPANGANAKAN) MULA TAONG 1985-2015
content_en:
STEP 1:
Download the Go Manila Mobile App or visit the website (
www.gomanila.com
).
STEP 2:
Register by creating an account on the Go Manila App using your email address and mobile number.
STEP 3:
Login to the Go Manila App using your registered email address.
STEP 4:
Go to Birth Certificate and complete the necessary information. Here’s the step-by-step guide:On the Go Manila Mobile App:
Click the Civil Registry Office icon
Under Select Transaction, click Birth Certificate
Click ProceedOn the Go Manila Website:
Click Select Transactions
Choose Civil Registry Office then click Birth Certificate
Click Proceed
STEP 5:
Complete the necessary information on the form then click Submit.
STEP 6:
Choose the preferred method for receiving the document:
Option 1 You may click Claim if you prefer personally getting it at the office.
Option 2 You may click Deliver if you prefer to have it delivered to your address.
STEP 7:
Click the Pay Now button to find the General reference number and QR code. This will expire within 24 hours.
STEP 8:
Settle the pending payment through either of these options:
Option 1 Pay to the nearest Bayad Center outlets and partners.
Option 2 Proceed payment on the app by using your credit or debit card.
content_tl:
UNANG HAKBANG:
Mag-download ng GO! MANILA MOBILE APP sa AppStore para sa IOS o sa PlayStore para sa Android
O pumunta sa website na GO MANILA WEB APP (
www.gomanila.com
).
PANGALAWANG HAKBANG:
Gumawa ng e-mail account o kaya ihanda ang email address sa pagrehistro sa GO MANILA MOBILE APP o sa GO MANILA WEB APP.
PANGATLONG HAKBANG:
Magrehistro at mag-log in sa GO MANILA MOBILE APP o sa GO MANILA WEB APP gamit ang inyong e-mail account.
PANG-APAT NA HAKBANG:
Sa mga gagamit ng GO MANILA MOBILE APP:
Pindutin ang CIVIL REGISTRY OFFICE na icon at hanapin ang BIRTH CERTIFICATE slider.
Para sa mga gagamit ng GO MANILA WEB APP:
Pindutin ang SELECT TRANSACTIONS;
Piliin ang CIVIL REGISTRY OFFICE;
Pindutin ang CIVIL REGISTRY OFFICE na icon at hanapin ang BIRTH CERTIFICATE slider.
Pindutin ang BIRTH CERTIFICATE slider; at
Pagkatapos ay pindutin ang PROCEED.
IKA-LIMANG HAKBANG:
Ilagay ang personal na impormasyon sa FORM na nakalaan at pindutin ang icon na SUBMIT.
IKA-ANIM NA HAKBANG:
Pumili at pindutin ang icon na CLAIM (kung personal na kukunin ang dokumento sa Tanggapan ng Talaang Sibil) o DELIVER (kung ipapa-deliver ang dokumento).
IKA-PITONG HAKBANG:
Pindutin ang PAY NOW button at ang GENERAL REFERENCE NUMBER at QR Code.
IKA-WALONG HAKBANG:
Pumunta sa pinakamalapit na BAYAD CENTER OUTLETS at PARTNERS o magbayad gamit ang inyong CREDIT CARD o ang inyong DEBIT CARD.
IKA-SIYAM NA HAKBANG:
Bayaran ang kaukulang presyo at kunin ang ACKNOWLEDGEMENT RECEIPT o resibo.
IKA-SAMPUNG HAKBANG:
Para personal na kukunin ang dokumento, pumunta sa Manila Civil Registry Office (Tanggapan ng Talaang Sibil ng Maynila) para kunin ang inyong Katunayan ng Kapanganakan(Birth Certificate).
Para sa mga gustong ipa-deliver ang dokumento, hintayin sa kani-kanilang mailing address ang dokumento.

title_en: STEPS IN SECURING OCCUPATIONAL PERMIT AND HEALTH CERTIFICATE THROUGH GO MANILA ONLINE SERVICES
title_tl: PROSESO SA PAGBABAYAD NG ORDINANCE VIOLATION RECEIPT (OVR)
content_en:
Download the Go Manila Mobile App or visit the website (
www.gomanila.com
).
Signup or Register and Log-in
Click on the Occupational / Health Permit Slider.
Select transaction type: NEW or RENEWAL then click on PROCEED
Enter Business Establishment and address followed by Personal Profile on the form and required fields then submit.
Review information and amount to be paid then again click on submit and confirm
Select desired available schedule for laboratory testing AM or PM then proceed
Click on pay now button and Generate Reference no. and QR code
Go to the nearest Bayad Center Outlets and Partners
Pay Designated Amount and claim acknowledgement receipt
Proceed to the Public Health Laboratory on your chosen schedule
For Public Health Laboratory (PHL)
You will receive a SMS message if your E-Health Certificate is ready to Download/Print.
To download and print your E-Health Certificate. Go to History, select the approved transaction and click Download/Print Health Certificate
For MHD/Earnshaw HC
You will receive a SMS message if your E-Health Certificate is ready to Download/Print.
To download and print your E-Health Certificate. Go to History, select the approved transaction and click Download/Print Health Certificate
For Bureau of Permits (Manila City Hall)
You will receive a SMS message if your E-Occupational Permit is ready to Download/Print.
To download and print your E-Occupational Permit
. Go to History, select the approved transaction and click Download/Print Occupational Permit
content_tl:
UNANG HAKBANG:
Mag-download ng GO MANILA MOBILE APP sa AppStore para sa IOS o sa PlayStore para sa Android
O pumunta sa website na GO MANILA WEB APP (
www.gomanila.com
).
PANGALAWANG HAKBANG:
Mag-sign up gamit ang inyong mobile number, ilagay ang pangalan, gumawa ng password at i-click ang terms and condition sa GO MANILA MOBILE APP o sa GO MANILA WEB APP.
Makakatanggap ka ng One Time Pin (OTP) para sa confirmation ng rehistro.
PANGATLONG HAKBANG:
Mag-log in sa GO MANILA MOBILE APP o sa GO MANILA WEB APP gamit ang inyong mobile number o e-mail account.
PANG-APAT NA HAKBANG:
Pindutin ang E-Government na icon at piliin ang OVR system
Piliin ang OVR Payment at i-click ang Proceed
I-review ang inyong information at ilagay ang OVR Number na matatagpuan sa violation ticket
Pumili ng Valid na ID para sa pag-priprisinta.
I-upload ang ticket gamit ang choose file at i-submit.
Ang status ng inyong transaksyon ay “For Checking” ibig sabihin nito ay vine-verify na ang inyong applikasyon at mag-hintay ng SMS galing sa GO Manila
IKA-LIMANG HAKBANG:
Kapag nakatanggap na ng SMS, pumunta sa inyong GO Manila transakyon at pindutin ang “Pay now” at i-click ang “YES” upang mag-redirect sa mga payment options.
IKA-ANIM NA HAKBANG:
Mga payment options at pamamaraan nito:
Visa/Mastercard – (Credit and Debit Cards)
I-click ang icon na visa/mastercard
Ilagay ang card information at i-click ang “checkout”
I-save ang acknowledgement receipt at makakatanggap ka ng SMS sa GO Manila para sa kumpirmasyon ng iyong pagbayad
Bayad Center Online App
I-click ang icon na Bayad Center App at i-click ang Proceed
Mag-kakaroon ka ng Reference Number at amount ng babayaran at i-save ito
Pumunta sa Bayad Center App at hanapin sa Billers ang Multipay
I-click ang Multipay na icon at ilagay ang reference number at amount na nagenerate.
I-save ang acknowledgement receipt at makakatanggap ka ng SMS sa GO Manila para sa kumpirmasyon ng iyong pagbayad
Bayad Center Outlet
I-click ang icon na Bayad Center at i-click ang Proceed
Mag-kakaroon ka ng Reference Number at amount ng babayaran at i-save ito
Pumunta sa Bayad Center Outlets at partners nito gaya ng LBC, VIllarica Pawnshop
Ipakita ang nakuhang Reference Number at amount at bayaran sa teller under ng Multipay Biller
I-save ang acknowledgement receipt at makakatanggap ka ng SMS sa GO Manila para sa kumpirmasyon ng iyong pagbayad.
Kiosk
I-click ang icon na Kiosk at i-click ang Proceed
Mag-kakaroon ka ng Reference Number at amount ng babayaran at i-save ito
Pumunta sa Service Kiosk Machine at ilagay ang reference number
Ilagay ang amount ng babayaran
I-save ang acknowledgement receipt at makakatanggap ka ng SMS sa GO Manila para sa kumpirmasyon ng iyong pagbayad.
Mga alternatibong paraan ng pagbayad:
Paglalagay ng Load sa GO Manila E-Wallet (Cash-In)
Pumunta sa Dashboard ng inyong account at i-click ang Cash-In sa E-wallet na icon
Ilagay ang gustong amount at i-click ang Add Cash at i-confirm
Mamili sa mga loading options:
E-wallets
Online Banking
Cash Payments
Banks
Ang cash-in limit ng E-wallet ay Php 25,000.00
Paggamit ng GO Manila E-Wallet sa pagbayad ng OVR
Pumunta sa Dashboard ng inyong account at i-click ang E-Bills na icon
I-click ang Government na category at piliin ang GO MANILA na Biller
Ilagay ang reference number at amount na nakuha sa inyong transaksyon at i-click ang pay transaction
I-save ang acknowledgement receipt at makakatanggap ka ng SMS sa GO Manila para sa kumpirmasyon ng iyong pagbayad.
Paggamit ng Gcash
Pumunta sa Gcash App at piliin ang Pay Bills
Piliin ang kategoryang Payment Solutions
Piliin at i-click ang GO MANILA na biller
Ilagay ang nakuhang reference number at amount ng transaksyon at i-click ang next
I-review ang information at i-click ang pay
I-save ang acknowledgement receipt at makakatanggap ka ng SMS sa GO Manila para sa kumpirmasyon ng iyong pagbayad.
IKA-PITONG HAKBANG:
Pumunta sa City Hall, OVR Area, Counter for tellers para kunin ang Official Receipt kapalit ang Acknowledgement Receipt
IKA-WALONG HAKBANG:
Pumunta sa Releasing Counter at iprisinta ang Official Receipt
I-claim ang Drivers License

title_en: HOW TO PRE-REGISTER YOUR BUSINESS FOR 2022 RENEWAL
title_tl: HOW TO PRE-REGISTER YOUR BUSINESS FOR 2022 RENEWAL
content_en:
HOW TO PRE-REGISTER YOUR BUSINESS FOR 2022 RENEWAL
1. Sign up and Log on to the App.
2. Go to Edit profile and click Businesses.

content_en:
REQUIREMENTS
·
Electronic OR
/
Tax Declaration
·
Owner’s ID
o
Authorization letter (if applicable)
SIGN UP
(for non-registered users)
1.
Install and open
GO MANILA APP or proceed to www.gomanila.com.
2.
Click SIGN UP and fill out personal information; create your password.
3.
Read and tick the checkbox to agree with the terms and condition and click SIGN UP.
4.
Enter the
one-time-pin (OTP) thru SMS.
5.
Fill out additional personal information and upload a valid photo and click SUBMIT.
APPLICATION
1.
Select
E-GOVERNMENT and click Real Property Tax (RPTAX).
2.
Select TAX CLEARANCE and click PROCEED.
3.
Enter Tax Declaration Number and Property Identification Number and PROCEED.
4.
Indicate the number of copies needed.
5.
Select any valid ID and the purpose of request.
6.
Upload the ff:
a)
Tax declaration
b)
Electronic OR
c)
Owner’s ID
7.
Pindutin ang SUBMIT.
STATUS
1.
Proceed to HISTORY or TRANSACTION HISTORY and check status:
a)
FOR CHECKING – yet to be processed.
b)
FOR RESUBMISSION – application has issue. Check remarks for more information.
c)
PENDING – Statement of Account (SOA) is viewable and ready for payment. Check HISTORY and click VIEW SOA.
d)
PAID – transaction is paid. Clearance is available for download or viewing.
PAYMENT
1.
Proceed to HISTORY and select transaction.
2.
Select
PAY NOW and select preferred payment method.
a)
Kiosk Machine
*only available at Manila City Hall.
*prepare exact amount as the machine does not give change in monetary form.
·
Screenshot the
QR Code
·
Scan the code in the QR scanner of the machine.
b)
E-Wallet (GCash, Paymaya, ShopeePay, etc)
·
Select preferred e-wallet
and follow the instructions.
c)
Visa / Mastercard
·
Enter the card information and proceed.
*Additional charge (convenience fee) may apply.
OFFICIAL RECEIPT
1.
Proceed to HISTORY and select the transaction.
2.
Select VIEW CLEARANCE and click DOWNLOAD view and download TAX CLEARANCE.
NOTE: The dowloading of clearance is limited to the amount paid. But printing of the downloaded clearance is unlimited.
NOTE: The clearance validity is a month after clicking the download button.
content_tl:
REQUIREMENTS
Magbigay ng alinman sa mga ss:
· Electronic OR
· Tax Declaration
· Owner’s ID
o Authorization letter (kung angkop)
SIGN UP
(kung kinakailangan)
1. Buksan ang GO MANILA APP o tumungo sa www.gomanila.com.
2. Pindutin ang SIGN UP at punan ang mga personal na impormasyon at gumawa ng sariling password.
3. Basahin at i-check ang kahon para sa terms and condition at pindutin ang SIGN UP.
4. Ilagay ang one time pin (OTP) na makukuha sa text na ipapadala sa iyong numero.
5. Punan ang mga personal na impormasyon at maglagay ng personal na larawan at pindutin ang SUBMIT.
APPLICATION
1. Piliin ang E-GOVERNMENT at pindutin ang Real Property Tax (RPTAX).
2. Piliin ang TAX CLEARANCE at pindutin ang PROCEED.
3. Ilagay ang Tax Declaration Number at Property Identification Number at pindutin ang PROCEED.
4. Ilagay kung ilang kopya ang kukuhanin.
5. Pumili ng valid ID at purpose ng pagkuha ng clearance.
6. Mag upload ng isa sa mga sumusunod:
a) Tax declaration
b) Electronic OR
c) Owner’s ID
7. Pindutin ang SUBMIT.
STATUS
1. Pumunta sa HISTORY o TRANSACTION HISTORY at tignan ang status:
a) FOR CHECKING – kapag hindi pa napo-proseso ang application.
b) FOR RESUBMISSION – kapag may problema sa ipinasa. Tignan ang remarks para sa karagdagang impormasyon
c) PENDING – Makikita na ang Statement of Account (SOA) at maari ng mabayaran. Tignan sa HISTORY at pindutin ang VIEW SOA.
d) PAID – nabayaran na ang transaksyon.
PAYMENT
1. Pumunta sa HISTORY at piliin ang transaksyon.
2. Pindutin ang PAY NOW at piliin ang nais na paraan ng pagbabayad.
a) Kiosk Machine
*ang mga makina ay nasa munisipyo ng Maynila lamang.
*maghanda ng eksaktong pambayad dahil hindi nagsusukli ang machine.
· I-screenshot ang QR Code
· Itapat ang QR code sa scanner ng machine.
b) E-Wallet (GCash, Paymaya, ShopeePay, atbp)
· Pumili ng nais na e-wallet at sundan ang instructions na makikita sa kanan.
c) Visa / Mastercard
· Ilagay ang impormasyon ng card at sundan ang mga instructions.
*May karagdagang system charge sa babayaran.
OFFICIAL RECEIPT
1. Pumunta sa HISTORY at pindutin ang transaksyon.
2. Pindutin ang VIEW CLEARANCE at piliin ang DOWNLOAD para magkaroon ng kopya ng TAX CLEARANCE.
NOTE: Ang pag download ng kopya ay limitado sa bilang ng binayaran. Ngunit ang nai-download ay maaaring ma-print ng ilang ulit.
NOTE:
Ang validity ng clearance ay isang buwan mula sa petsa ng pag download.
